handNote.desc: Identical to Hand 3 of Ambalage, Tamazzo Māryām, TZM-002. Broad, rounded script, somewhat irregular. The loops of መ are attached, the right loop is bent. The vowel marker of እ is bent laterally. The loop of ቶ is very big. The vowel markers of ን, ት and ዝ are set up on the stem curved left. Numerals are mostly written without dashes, but also with (). ፈ and ረ are quite angular. The vowel marker of ሬ and ፌ can extend below the line (). The hand belongs probably to Uhlig's period II, but a slightly later date cannot be excluded.
